cohort: 5884 children born in the 5 years preceding the 2014 Ghana Demographic and Health Survey (GDHS)
finding: The study found a neonatal mortality prevalence of 2.8% and identified several risk factors including receiving prenatal care from a non-skilled worker, multiple births, delivery via cesarean section, and household size.
mod_finding: Babies delivered through cesarean section had an increased risk of neonatal death.
